text:
Riley: Morning team — baby decided to come early, planning to start leave next Thursday. Quick runbook: who do I tell about payroll cutoffs and benefits?

Asha (People Ops): Huge congrats Riley! :tada: Payroll and benefits are two separate forms. If you can tell us the exact start date today we can make sure the payroll code is set before cutoff.

Nate (Benefits): Riley — for benefits: you can change dependent coverage up to 60 days after birth, but FSA/HSA elections must be updated within 30 days. If you want to enroll the newborn in health insurance immediately we need the birth certificate/SSN within 60 days. Send scans to benefits@redwood.com.

Riley: Thanks. What about equipment? Will be in hospital for a couple days.

Priya (Eng Mgr): I can take the oncall for the first week. For handoff paste a short list of active alerts and any long-running jobs. No need for a long doc.

Riley: Will do. Example snippet below I can paste to #eng-oncall: 
``
Active alerts: billing-latency > 95th pct
Long jobs: nightly-embed-index (monitor mem usage)
PRs waiting: #912 fix for quantization test
``

Asha (People Ops): Equipment: if you take laptop home now, log it in the asset portal. If not, we can ship a spare, but shipping after leave start might add delay. I'll link the asset form in a DM.

Ops Bot: Reminder scheduled: If People Ops confirms leave start, send LOA confirmation email template and enable OOO auto-reply.

Nate (Benefits): For payroll top-up: company offers a partial top-up for primary caregivers — fill the top-up request and sign it. We need manager sign-off and a short pay schedule note.

Riley: Can you drop the links and I'll e-sign from the hospital wifi?

Asha (People Ops): Links: https://redwood.hr/leave-request https://redwood.hr/top-up-request https://redwood.hr/asset-form

Priya (Eng Mgr): I'll pre-sign the top-up once it's prefilled. Riley — DM me start/end window and I'll post a brief rota update.

Riley: DM sent. Really appreciate the coverage.

Asha (People Ops): Congrats again! Marking paperwork todos; ping here if anything changes. :heart:
